content:
sophia: Quick async standup — heads up on a few pipeline asks. Drop 1-line: what you did / blockers / today. Highlight any enterprise security (KMS/HSM, data residency) stuff and I'll consolidate.

ryan: Moved NovaHealth to dedicated pilot. Blocker: legal wants KMS integration details + confirmation on HSM BYOK timeline.

marta: FYI I sent legal the high-level KMS key-wrap doc link and asked the customer to fill the security questionnaire (key custody Q5). Waiting on their answer.

alex: On HSM integration PR (3 files). Code-review ping @marta @jamie — small change in kms_adapter.go. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/452

jamie: Jumping in. For the pilot we can offer KMS proxy + BYOK; full HSM procurement is ~6 weeks. If they require on-prem HSM it's longer.

sophia: @ryan can you confirm whether NovaHealth needs HSM now or if KMS with CMEK is ok? Also need to know if EU data residency is a must.

ryan: Customer prefers BYOK + EU region. Procurement sign-off is the blocker — ETA next Tue.

marta: Added customer_eu_region: true to the intake sheet and flagged infra. Also asked security to prioritize SOC2 scoping for this pilot.

infra-bot: Notice: Dedicated capacity in eu-west-1 currently has ~12% spare — we can provision a pilot with a 1-node burst. :information_source:

jamie: Ops checklist for dedicated pilot (quick snippet):
```
pilot:
  region: eu-west-1
  kms_required: true
  hsm_requested: optional
  sla: 99.9
```

sophia: Perfect. @alex please drop the PR link and tag it with "security-review" label so we can track. Also remind AE to request the customer's KMS key policy doc.

alex: Done — PR labeled and @security pinged. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/452 :thumbsup:

marta: Quick ask from legal: can we provide an architecture diagram showing key flow for BYOK? I can sketch but prefer infra to confirm.

jamie: I'll put a rough diagram in Confluence and share the link here. ETA: today EOD.

sophia: Thanks — I'll update the deal thread and notify the AE. If anything else pops up, drop a 1-line update here. —s
